description: Nothing new is installed, pulled, or imported into the ASAA ecosystem without an owner approval record. New npm or Python packages, Docker images, command-line tools, and bulk data imports are blocked until approved here. The approved baseline is snapshotted in policy/approved-dependencies.json and re-checked by checks/check-dependency-approval.mjs.
scope: npm and Node packages (package.json dependencies and devDependencies)
Docker images and compose image references
Command-line tools and runtimes installed on this laptop for the ecosystem
Bulk data imports into any project database or identity store

example.what: package name, image tag, tool or import source

approvalRecordRequired.location: policy/install-import-approvals.json (created when the first approval is granted)

rules.rule: Every new dependency, Docker image, tool, or bulk import requires an approval record before it is added or run.

Dependency manifests (package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements*.txt) are snapshotted into approved-dependencies.json. Any dependency absent from the snapshot fails the check until approved and re-snapshotted.
Docker images must use an exact tag. The 'latest' tag and unpinned references are not allowed.
Only images listed in approvedDockerImages may be used. Adding an image requires an approval record first.
Snapshot refresh (check-dependency-approval.mjs --snapshot) is run only after an approval record exists for every change it captures.
Bulk data imports into a system of record need an approval record that names the source, the target, the personal-data classification, and the rollback method.
Zero-cost default: paid products, paid licences and paid cloud services are not approved by this policy.
